missing_values: errno/strerror only when the exception carries an int errno / str strerror; otherwise null; original_type null when there is no cause
privacy: the full text (with the local port path) stays in the session's own move.json; public copies replace home paths

cases: ConnectionError with empty first line + OSError(16) cause -> errno 16 'Device or resource busy', chain raised/cause, detail no longer empty
cause without errno (SerialException-like) -> errno null, cause message kept
bare ConnectionError, empty first line, no cause -> message kept, original_type null, errno null
failure while constructing the bus -> stage 'construct', errno 2
grip() open failure -> same chain record
